boundaries: macOS arm64 only. Exact fake timer boundaries with real filesystem/native IO; no simulated native receipts in the main H05/H06 integration matrix.

H06 DOM events are synthetic in jsdom and flow through actual production EditorView/MutationObserver/transactions. Syntax/preview workers and unrelated renderer IPC initialization are mocked. Not physical system IME, Electron window input, or App GUI.
The separate panel test uses real panel/store/buffer/EditorView but mocks native file APIs.
No source-file candidate write is permitted while input is pending or interrupted. Interrupted candidate remains in memory/history; no candidate-specific durable recovery or crash guarantee is added.
No new installation package was created. Root owns unified package and actual App/system IME regression.
steps: 修改后推进499/500ms，含undo历史但内容clean时也观察snapshot。
expected: 快照500ms与保存3s分开；有历史可保留，clean且无历史清draft。
actual: 真实Markdown：499ms无草稿/保存，500ms恢复目录有对应hash/baseHash全文；2999ms源仍旧，3000ms源更新、clean且草稿清理。真实undo回base保留redo历史但不写源、过时草稿清除；redo再按500mscheckpoint；显式disk重读后clean/无历史/无draft。历史仅保留内存，未宣称跨重启undo栈。
